title: Medical workers arrested during protest in Chennai

ai.summary: Over 200 multi-purpose medical workers were arrested in Chennai after protesting near Rajarathinam Stadium demanding permanent employment and benefits, following police denial of protest permission.

facts.claim: More than 200 multi-purpose medical workers were arrested after staging a protest near Rajarathinam Stadium in Egmore on Monday
facts.quote: More than 200 multi-purpose medical workers were arrested after staging a protest near Rajarathinam Stadium in Egmore on Monday

facts.claim: Police also placed several protest organisers and workers under house arrest in different parts of Tamil Nadu to prevent them from reaching Chennai for the planned agitation
facts.quote: Police also placed several protest organisers and workers under house arrest in different parts of Tamil Nadu to prevent them from reaching Chennai for the planned agitation

facts.claim: More than 2,500 multi-purpose medical workers are employed on a daily-wage basis in government hospitals across Tamil Nadu
facts.quote: More than 2,500 multi-purpose medical workers are employed on a daily-wage basis in government hospitals across Tamil Nadu

facts.claim: They had planned to stage a hunger strike at Rajarathinam Stadium in Egmore on Monday, pressing for permanent employment, one day of leave a month and other demands
facts.quote: They had planned to stage a hunger strike at Rajarathinam Stadium in Egmore on Monday, pressing for permanent employment, one day of leave a month and other demands

facts.claim: Police denied permission for the proposed protest and reportedly detained several office-bearers and workers at their residences in Chennai and other districts to prevent the agitation
facts.quote: Police denied permission for the proposed protest and reportedly detained several office-bearers and workers at their residences in Chennai and other districts to prevent the agitation

ai.background_note: Tamil Nadu hospital workers, employed on daily wages since 2013-2014, have demanded permanent employment and benefits after being promised permanency after five years of service.
